subject: System Design
title: Eventual Consistency
description: A quick win: understand Eventual Consistency.

hook.text: You post a photo on Instagram. Your friend in London doesn't see it for 3 seconds. Is the database broken?

buildup.text: Eventual consistency means all replicas will converge to the same value — eventually, not instantly.

discovery.text: For 3 seconds, different replicas may return different results. This is the trade-off for global availability.

twist.text: For most social media features, eventual consistency is fine. For bank transfers, it's unacceptable.

climax.text: Eventual consistency isn't a bug — it's a deliberate design choice to achieve availability at global scale.

punchline.text: Not instant, but eventually correct everywhere.

quiz.question: What does eventual consistency guarantee?
options: All replicas will converge to the same value over time
No data will ever be lost
